item.description:
Symphonia 1.1 shows a logo and a photo for each artist, from images you keep in the artist's folder.

  • Artist logos and photos. Put a logo.png and an artist.jpg (or folder.jpg) in an artist's folder, the one that holds their album folders. Symphonia picks them up by itself, and Odeion shows the logo in its Artists list and the photo, with the logo over it, at the top of the artist's page. Other UPnP apps that show artist pictures get the logo, or the photo when there's no logo. Transparent logos keep their see-through background.
  • Find them with The Splitter. The Splitter's Tools > Find Artist Logos… looks up logos and photos for every artist in your library on fanart.tv and saves the ones you choose in the right folders.
  • Which folder is the artist's. Symphonia uses the folder above an artist's albums when it's named for the artist, or when every album in it is theirs, so a shared or genre folder isn't mistaken for one artist's.
